# Exact conditioning data

## Reference frame-factor bridge and bounds

Let `D` be the exact positive diagonal factor in the reference whitening and
let `G_1,...,G_5` be the rational representatives of its five trace-projected
functionals.  The exact rational frame Gram is

`(H_inc)_jk = tr(G_j D^-1 G_k D^-1) - tr(G_j D^-1) tr(G_k D^-1)/4`.

It is rank five and positive definite.  On the whitened pair cone,
with `K_hat_inc` the exact whitened reference kernel, the frame-factor bridge
is the one-sided inequality

`F >= lambda_min(H_inc) (2 - h) >= lambda_min(H_inc) m(K_hat_inc)`.

The rational lower bracket is

`s_lo = 812873440394747353670787185015095602549 /
105051913151663586578335579326020229005312`,

with `s_lo < lambda_min(H_inc)`.  The reference-frame certificate proves

`m(K_hat_inc) >= 1/1024`

and therefore

`min F >= L0 = s_lo/1024
       = 812873440394747353670787185015095602549 /
         107573159067303512656215633229844714501439488
       ~= 7.556470846841732e-6`.

Together with the already exact upper bound

`M0 = 270988332696903/281474976710656`,

the reference map satisfies

`sqrt(L0) d_angle/pi <= ||Phi(R1)-Phi(R2)|| <= sqrt(M0) d_angle/2`,

and hence

`c_inc >= sqrt(L0)/pi ~= 8.750031830575377e-4`,

`kappa_inc <= (pi/2) sqrt(M0/L0) ~= 560.6809131191`.

All inequality directions are essential.  The exact rationals and one-sided
certificates control; the decimals are display aids only.

The certified `1/1024` rung processed 184301 boxes, closed 87525, pruned 4626,
and left zero undecided.  The independent verifier passed 32447 clean checks,
re-established all 875 sampled closed boxes, and rejected eight negative-test
classes.  Its positive-control replay of the comparison construction processed
4141 boxes, closed 1786, pruned 285, and left zero undecided.

For the 30 September edition the complete subdivisions were regenerated
and retained in `complete_projector_cover.json` and
`complete_rational_cover.json`. The accompanying engine replays all leaves
and checks the full partition; see `COMPLETE_COVER_PROOF.md`. The older
sampled checks by themselves do not certify exhaustive coverage.

The separate `K*` floor `1/32` is exactly 32 times the reference certified
floor `1/1024`.  The ratio of the certified lower-bound values is

`(1/(pi sqrt(32))) / (sqrt(L0)/pi) = 1/sqrt(32 L0) ~= 64.3081`.

This does not compare the unknown true minima, true stability constants,
optimal designs, or physical performance.

## Exact rational `K*` kernel data

The separate kernel is the rational four-plane

`K* = span_Q{K1, K2, K3, K4} subset Sym_0(4,Q)`.

`conditioning/p6_t1c/results/P6_T1C_DESIGN0_RESULTS_20260813.json`.

Direct exact rational recomputation gives `rank_Q(B_1,...,B_6) = 6`,
`tr(B_a K_j) = 0` for every `a = 1,...,6` and `j = 1,...,4`, and
`I_4 = B_1 + B_4 + B_6`. Thus these six printed matrices are a full rational
basis of the displayed perpendicular space and explicitly include the identity
witness.

## Exact compression, normalization, and realization assumptions

Let `W` be the unit trace-zero symmetric slice used by the construction.
With `t_i(Z) = tr(K_i Z)` and `G_ij = tr(K_i K_j)`, the exact normalization is

`m(K) = min_{Z in W}(||Z||_F^2 - ||Pi_K Z||_F^2) = 2 - max_{Z in W} h_K(Z)`,

where `h_K(Z) = t(Z)^T G^{-1} t(Z)`. The certified stage-two reduction is

`max_W h_K = max_{c != 0} spread(sum_a c_a K_a)^2 / (c^T G c)`

and hence `m(K) = 2 - s*(K)^2`. These are normalization and realization
relations for the separate abstract construction; they do not replace the
independently certified reference quantities above.

Let

`H = {x in R^6 : x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 = 0}`.

For `1 <= i <= 5` and `1 <= j <= 6`, define the `5 x 6` matrix `L` by

```text
L[i,j] =  1/sqrt(i(i+1))     when j <= i,
         -i/sqrt(i(i+1))     when j = i+1,
          0                  when j > i+1.
```

The exact T1c computation verifies `L L^T = I_5` and
`||L x||_2 = ||x||_2` for every `x in H`. In the stated partial-isometric
realization, the six-reading difference norm squared is `m(K)` on the worst
direction, and H-isometric five-functional compression preserves it. If the
first five coordinates are `u`, then `x6 = -sum(u)` and

`||x||_2^2 = u^T (I_5 + 1 1^T) u`.

The associated drop-coordinate metric has eigenvalues `1` (multiplicity four)
and `6` (multiplicity one). This identifies the exact realization only; it does
not silently substitute any other five-coordinate convention for `L`.

## Certified bounded statements

The comparison stage-two exact certificate uses the normalized spread-pencil identity

`max_W h_K = max_{c != 0} spread(sum_a c_a K_a)^2 / (c^T G c)`

together with `m(K) = 2 - s*(K)^2`.  For the exact `K*` above it certifies

`m(K*) >= 1/32`.

Only if both of the following are retained exactly may the displayed
rotation-angle constant be used:

1. the reference difference-linearity, spectral-normal-form, and
   cone-coincidence hypotheses; and
2. the `H` partial-isometric realization `L` specified above.

Under precisely those hypotheses, the separate construction has

`c >= 1/(pi sqrt(32)) > 0.0562`.

The current manuscript constructs these hypotheses explicitly: choose any
linear isometry T from E=K*^perp intersect Sym_0(4) to H (both have dimension
five), and set Psi_6(R(q))=T Pi_E(qq^T-I/4). This gives the required
difference-linearity and makes the bound unconditional for that abstract
coordinate construction. It is not a replacement of the six-projector
certificate, a transfer of its frame factor, or a device-realization claim.
